name: Dental care (category guide)
summary: Private chairs vs polyclinic / NDC pathways for foreigners — full fees, no EP MediSave, MOH fee benchmarks, and corporate dental carve-outs.
body: EP and most S Pass holders do not have MediSave and do not get citizen/PR dental subsidies. Polyclinic dental can refer to National Dental Centre or hospital specialists, but waits are long and foreigner pricing is unsubsidised — private is usually the practical path for acute pain, wisdom teeth, and hygiene. Before you book, check whether your group medical rider excludes dental entirely or only caps cleaning; MOH’s published dental fee benchmarks are a negotiation anchor, not a guarantee. Wisdom-tooth surgery myths about MediSave claims fail for EP holders without CPF MediSave — budget cash/card and ask for a written quote with x-ray. JB dental tourism is common on Reddit; due-diligence and remediable follow-up matter more than the first quote. Pair with a familiar GP network only if they actually offer dental chairs on your panel — many do not. Teen braces and Invisalign courses are a separate cash stack from cleaning — see the kids braces guide for NDCS vs private and mid-posting transfer traps. Family ops note: sports-day / carnival weeks are a poor time to discover an untreated toothache — keep routine kids checks off peak school-event calendars when you can.
